name: Lakitelek (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Lakitelek: a shield of blue and green with a white horse and a wavy stripe, with a helm and red, yellow and blue mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Lakitelek arms with helm and mantling
